markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1] with full model agreement; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stains are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive score; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%, 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Reliable input; atypical OOD (70% AUROC) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (71%–79% similarity) [F5] | All five reference neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (+1.24 contribution) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (-1.74 score, +1.17 contribution) push toward invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma (-0.94 score, +0.87 contribution) supports invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · High stromal infiltration score (+0.82 contribution; 19/20 spot check) · Validated
- **HoVer-Net tumor nuclei** (regions 7, 10, 11) · context · 71% tumor fraction [F7], 2620/mm² density [F8], 93rd-percentile size variation [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random removal (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006); leans on Unreliable **mitoses** (0/20) and **necrosis** (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Small mean nuclear size (50 µm², 10th percentile [F9]) reflects a cellular benign mimic like BACH_0023 (61% similar).
- Classifier relies on unverified visual cues, since concept explanations failed deletion testing and mitoses is Unreliable.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: Confirm stromal invasion (100% risk), high tumor density, nuclear pleomorphism, and TILs [F12].
2. **Regions 0, 5, 6**: Count mitotic figures manually, as the Unreliable mitoses concept scored 0/20 in validation.
3. **Region 3**: Verify absence of benign tubule architecture compared with benign contrast case BACH_0023.
